tldr: 台股中秋連假前最後交易日（9/24）收在48,024點、跌約0.28%，權值股台積電逆勢漲1%，連假期間休市。
SEMICON Taiwan盛會與台積電營收指引使AI、半導體續居市場核心，但建廠人力與機台交期瓶頸凸顯執行面風險。
金管會為壽險業接軌TIS新制、迎接9月底資本大考鬆綁過渡措施；亞洲資產管理中心與主動式ETF延續財管動能。
台灣遺贈稅法修正上路，CPI連4月破2%，稅務規劃與通膨續為市場關注焦點。
華爾街收下三週來首見週線紅，AI買盤與油價回落抵銷逼近廿年高的公債殖利率；好市多財報勝估、耐吉遭降評。

items.title_zh: 台股連假前量縮收黑、台積電逆勢走高
items.summary_zh: 台股於中秋連假前最後交易日（9/24）以48,024.60點作收、跌約0.28%，權值股台積電逆勢上漲1%至2,475元。連假期間台股休市，加權指數維持此一水準進入新一週，投資人靜待節後資金與AI題材的動向。
items.summary_en: **Taipei bourse shut for Mid-Autumn holiday after a soft final session.** The TAIEX finished its last pre-holiday trading day on Sept 24 at 48,024.60, down about 0.28%, while TSMC bucked the trend to close up 1% at NT$2,475. With trading suspended through the Mid-Autumn Festival break, the benchmark carries this level into the new week as investors await post-holiday flows.

items.title_zh: 台積電有望成2026年最大贏家
items.summary_zh: 台積電管理階層對2026年全年營收給出約三成成長指引，並預期AI相關營收至2029年將以近60%的年複合成長率擴張。AI建置需求持續驅動晶圓龍頭營運，也讓台積電穩居全球半導體循環與台股行情核心。
items.summary_en: **TSMC shapes up as 2026's quiet winner on relentless AI demand.** Management guides for revenue growth of roughly 30% in 2026 and expects AI-related revenue to compound at close to 60% annually through 2029. The outlook underscores how the AI build-out keeps the foundry leader at the center of the global chip cycle and Taiwan's equity story heading into the new week.

items.title_zh: SEMICON Taiwan盛會聚焦AI、矽光子與先進封裝
items.summary_zh: 半導體年度盛會SEMICON Taiwan 2026登場，參展廠商達1,300家、4,300個攤位雙創新高，大師論壇首度全天舉行。議題橫跨雲端算力、HBM記憶體、高速互連與先進封裝，凸顯台灣自晶圓製造向封裝、測試、材料與設備的完整AI硬體供應鏈延伸。
items.summary_en: **SEMICON Taiwan 2026 spotlights AI, silicon photonics and advanced packaging.** The island's flagship semiconductor showcase drew a record 1,300 exhibitors across 4,300 booths, with the Executive Forum running a full day for the first time. Sessions spanned cloud compute, HBM memory, high-speed interconnects and advanced packaging, framing Taiwan's expansion from wafer fabrication into the full AI hardware supply chain.

items.title_zh: 台積電示警建廠人力與機台交期瓶頸
items.summary_zh: 台積電侯永清指出，整體生態系尚未準備好因應全球建廠潮，營造人力短缺成為限制之一，機台設備需求半年內翻倍，導致供應商供貨吃緊。此番談話點出AI帶動的資本支出循環背後，仍存在建廠與設備交期等執行面風險。
items.summary_en: **TSMC flags construction and equipment bottlenecks behind the global fab boom.** Executive Y.C. Hou said the ecosystem is not fully prepared for the worldwide wave of new plants: skilled construction labor is scarce and tool demand has doubled within six months, leaving equipment suppliers unable to keep pace. The comments highlight the execution risks lurking behind the AI-driven capital-spending cycle.

items.title_zh: 金管會鬆綁過渡措施助壽險接軌TIS
items.summary_zh: 因應壽險業由RBC接軌新一代清償能力制度TIS，金管會核准過渡措施，讓8家以壽險為主體的金控資本壓力大減，並准許11家金控延後一個月申報資本適足率，以緩解新舊資本標準轉換的衝擊，協助業者平順接軌以「自有資本÷風險資本」計算的新制。
items.summary_en: **FSC grants transitional capital relief as insurers adopt the new TIS regime.** Under the shift to the new solvency system replacing RBC, regulators approved measures easing capital pressure for eight insurance-focused financial-holding groups and let eleven holding companies defer their capital-adequacy filings by a month. The steps smooth the transition to the tougher own-capital-over-risk-capital standard now taking effect.

items.title_zh: 壽險9月底TIS資本首考可望全數過關
items.summary_zh: 壽險業首份TIS期中資本申報須於9月底完成，金管會祭出兩項穩定資本措施協助業者達標，市場普遍預期本次首考可望全數過關。此次大考是檢視壽險業資本韌性的重要關卡，攸關後續接軌新制與商品策略的調整空間。
items.summary_en: **Life insurers head into their end-September TIS capital test likely to pass.** The first interim TIS report is due by the end of September, and the FSC has deployed two stabilising measures so insurers can meet the threshold, with the sector widely expected to clear the maiden test. The exercise is a key checkpoint for the industry's capital resilience under the new framework.

items.title_zh: 安聯投信推2026首檔台股主動式ETF
items.summary_zh: 安聯投信推出2026年首檔台股主動式ETF，並由LINE Bank擔任全台唯一獨家預購通路，擴大投資人參與主動選股策略的管道。此檔產品反映台灣投資人對主動式ETF興趣升溫，尋求在被動指數型商品之外爭取超額報酬的資產配置需求。
items.summary_en: **Allianz Global Investors launches its first actively managed Taiwan-equity ETF for 2026.** The new active ETF debuts with LINE Bank as the exclusive channel for pre-orders across Taiwan, widening retail access to actively managed equity strategies. The launch reflects growing appetite among Taiwanese investors for active ETFs that seek alpha beyond passive index products in their asset allocation.

items.title_zh: 亞洲資產管理中心提前達標、高資產成引擎
items.summary_zh: 政府2024年啟動的亞洲資產管理中心政策，透過五大計畫與跨部會協作，資產管理規模已於2025年底提前達成兩年政策目標。高資產財富管理仍是推升規模的核心引擎，金管會並放寬銀行對資產達新台幣1億元以上客戶提供多元商品與諮詢服務的條件。
items.summary_en: **Taiwan's Asia asset-management hub push hits its two-year AUM goal early.** The government's asset-management centre initiative, launched in 2024 with five programmes and cross-agency coordination, saw managed assets reach the policy's two-year target ahead of schedule by end-2025. High-net-worth wealth management remains a core engine, with regulators easing rules for clients holding over NT$100m in assets.

items.title_zh: 遺贈稅法修正正式上路、財政部列4大重點
items.summary_zh: 賴總統於9月11日公布遺產及贈與稅法部分條文修正，涉及擬制遺產稅額分算、配偶剩餘財產差額分配、經法院判決確定遺產權屬案件的申報期間，以及繳納方式放寬等。財政部表示將加強宣導，協助繼承人掌握新制下的納稅義務與可運用選項。
items.summary_en: **Amended Estate and Gift Tax Act takes effect with four key changes.** President Lai promulgated the amendment on Sept 11, revising rules on deemed-estate tax apportionment, the spousal remainder-property claim, filing periods for estate-ownership cases settled by court, and payment flexibility. The Ministry of Finance says it will step up public outreach so heirs understand the new obligations and options.

items.title_zh: 取消分期繳納門檻、繳稅方式同步放寬
items.summary_zh: 修法刪除遺贈稅應納稅額須達新台幣30萬元以上始可申請分期繳納的限制，擴大適用範圍；並增訂繼承人得以多數決方式，動用遺產中的存款繳稅。此舉降低繼承人對繳稅方式難以達成共識時的阻力，讓資金安排更具彈性。
items.summary_en: **Installment-payment threshold scrapped to ease taxpayers' burden.** The amendment removes the previous rule that only estate- and gift-tax bills of NT$300,000 or more could be paid in installments, broadening access to deferred payment. It also lets heirs decide by majority to settle tax using bank deposits within the estate, reducing friction when beneficiaries cannot immediately agree on how to fund the liability.

items.title_zh: CPI連4月破2%、主計總處估9月漲幅恐擴大
items.summary_zh: 主計總處公布8月消費者物價指數（CPI）年增2.04%，扣除蔬果、能源的核心CPI升至2.3%，雙雙高於2%通膨警戒線。主計總處預期9月漲幅將續擴大，主因蔬菜批發行情每公斤逾40元，加上外食與旅遊相關費用調高，推升物價壓力。
items.summary_en: **Taiwan's CPI stays above the 2% alert line for a fourth month.** August consumer prices rose 2.04% year-on-year while core CPI, excluding fruit, vegetables and energy, climbed to 2.3%, both above the 2% inflation-warning threshold. The DGBAS expects September's increase to widen further, citing vegetable prices topping NT$40 per kilogram and higher dining-out and travel costs.

items.title_zh: 外食費衝3.17%創8個月最大漲幅、物價壓力擴散
items.summary_zh: 8月外食費年增3.17%，為8個月來最大漲幅，反映廠商轉嫁人事與租金成本。油料費漲約1成、燃油附加費推升國際機票價格，加上旅遊團費調高，帶動服務類物價走高，使9月CPI估連5月突破通膨警戒線。
items.summary_en: **Dining-out costs post largest rise in eight months as price pressure broadens.** Restaurant-meal prices jumped 3.17% year-on-year in August, the biggest gain in eight months, as firms passed on higher labour and rent costs. Fuel prices rose around 10% and surcharges lifted international airfares, while pricier travel packages added to services inflation, keeping September CPI on track to breach 2% for a fifth straight month.

items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體報導，美股道瓊指數上漲約0.93%至51,862點，微軟、宣偉、安進等科技與權值股領漲，AI股買盤回籠、油價回落，帶動美股克服公債殖利率高檔壓力，於週末前收紅，牽動台股節後開盤的市場情緒。
items.summary_en: **Wall Street closes higher with the Dow up nearly 1%, as Taiwan media track the rally.** Local outlets reported that the Dow jumped about 0.93% to 51,862, with tech and blue chips such as Microsoft, Sherwin-Williams and Amgen leading gains, as renewed AI buying and softer oil helped U.S. stocks overcome pressure from high bond yields into the weekend.

items.title_zh: 市場關注美股「9月魔咒」歷史最弱月份
items.summary_zh: 台灣財經媒體指出，9月歷來為美股最弱月份，標普500與道瓊平均約下跌1.1%，投資人關注季節性因素與高殖利率是否壓抑漲勢；惟AI相關需求仍為市場情緒提供支撐，成為觀察第四季走勢的關鍵。
items.summary_en: **Investors weigh Wall Street's "September curse" as the historically weakest month.** Taiwan financial media flagged that September has historically been the U.S. market's weakest month, with the S&P 500 and Dow averaging declines of around 1.1%, prompting local investors to watch whether seasonality and elevated yields could cap gains even as AI-related demand underpins sentiment heading into the fourth quarter.

items.title_zh: 美股收高、寫下三週來首見週線紅（2026-09-26）
items.title_en: U.S. stocks end higher, notching first winning week in three (2026-09-26)
items.summary_zh: 美股上週五收紅，道瓊漲約0.93%至51,828點、標普500漲0.49%至7,742點、那斯達克漲0.48%至27,069點。AI相關個股買盤回籠、油價回落，協助美股抵銷公債殖利率走高的壓力，三大指數同步收下三週來首見的週線紅。
items.summary_en: Wall Street closed higher Friday, with the Dow up about 0.93% to 51,828, the S&P 500 up 0.49% to 7,742 and the Nasdaq up 0.48% to 27,069. Renewed buying in AI-related shares and easing oil prices helped the market shrug off another week of pressure from rising Treasury yields.

items.title_zh: 美債殖利率逼近廿年高、油價隨美伊消息震盪（2026-09-25）
items.title_en: Treasury yields hover near two-decade highs as oil swings on Iran headlines (2026-09-25)
items.summary_zh: 美國30年期公債殖利率一度升抵約5.47%、創22年新高，10年期週五回落至約5.17%。油價先前因美伊衝突升破每桶百美元，之後傳出雙方或洽談分階段重啟荷莫茲海峽的協議而回落，殖利率與油價牽動市場對通膨與Fed政策預期。
items.summary_en: The 30-year U.S. Treasury yield touched about 5.47%, a 22-year high, while the 10-year eased to around 5.17% Friday. Oil, which had spiked above $100 on the U.S.-Iran conflict, pulled back on reports negotiators may explore a phased deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title_zh: 好市多第四季財報優於預期、高盛看後市（2026-09-25）
items.title_en: Costco beats on fiscal Q4 as Goldman sees further upside (2026-09-25)
items.summary_zh: 好市多（Costco）公布本財年第四季財報優於預期，每股盈餘6.60美元高於市場預估的6.53美元，營收957.2億美元同樣勝估。高盛維持買進評等，認為這家量販龍頭正有效因應總經壓力，看好股價仍有上行空間。
items.summary_en: Costco reported better-than-expected fiscal fourth-quarter results, with earnings of $6.60 a share topping the $6.53 consensus and revenue of $95.72 billion also beating estimates. Goldman Sachs kept a buy rating, saying the warehouse retailer is navigating macro pressures well and sees room for the stock to move higher.

items.title_zh: 美銀轉趨保守、耐吉財報前股價走弱（2026-09-25）
items.title_en: Nike slips as Bank of America turns bearish before results (2026-09-25)
items.summary_zh: 耐吉（Nike）股價承壓，美銀（BofA）下修評等並調降目標價，警告這家運動用品龍頭的轉型面臨風險升高。在財報公布前，投資人消化此一轉趨保守的看法，股價下跌約0.7%，市場關注其後續營運能否重回成長軌道。
items.summary_en: Nike shares came under pressure after Bank of America downgraded the stock, warning that risks to the sportswear giant's turnaround are rising and cutting its price target. The stock eased about 0.7% as investors weighed the cautious call ahead of Nike's upcoming quarterly report.
